title: Canadian-based Neopharm Labs Completes Acquisition of Boston-Based Averica Discovery Services
主要内容: Neopharm Labs Inc., a Canadian-based company, completed the acquisition of Averica Discovery Services Inc., a Contract Research Organization (CRO) based in the Greater Boston area. This acquisition expands Neopharm's geographic reach into the U.S. and enhances its service offerings in the pharmaceutical testing industry. The merger combines expertise in small molecule analysis and purification, positioning Neopharm as a leader in analytical services. Averica's President, Dr. Jeffrey Kiplinger, joins Neopharm's Executive Team as Vice President, Science & Innovation. The acquisition supports chemistry teams by providing material and information required to transition programs from drug discovery to development. Averica Discovery Services offers chromatography-based services, including method development and qualification, impurity isolation and identification, scalable small molecule purification, and custom assay development.
